description: This is a Java test class for the ShardingSuite component, testing test class filtering and sharding logic in a JUnit environment.

classes.name: ShardingSuiteTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for verifying the behavior of the ShardingSuite, including class filtering and sharding logic.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, mocks dependencies, and verifies initial class filtering.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Clears system properties after each test.

methods.name: testDoesNotIncludeClassesWithoutTestAnnotation
methods.description: Verifies classes without test annotations are excluded.

methods.name: testDoesNotIncludeClassesWithSuiteAnnotation
methods.description: Verifies classes with suite annotations are excluded.

methods.name: testSkipsOutOfRangeHashedClasses
methods.description: Verifies classes outside the sharding range are excluded.

methods.name: testIncludesClassesWithRunWithRunnerAnnotations
methods.description: Checks inclusion of classes with @RunWith annotations.

methods.name: testIncludesClassesWithMethodsWithTestAnnotation
methods.description: Checks inclusion of classes with test methods.

methods.name: testMustHashShardingWithAnnotation
methods.description: Ensures that classes without proper sharding annotations throw an InitializationError.
